values.title: My Approach
values.subtitle: These three values shape my work and help me ensure the highest quality in every project.
values.card1Text: I look 'under the hood' to understand architecture and hardware constraints, providing developers with precise, actionable, and technically grounded defect reports.
values.card2Text: From managing IT demands for over 1,000 users to the fast-paced environment of AAA game development, I stay focused and solve critical problems on the fly.
values.card3Text: I believe the best products come from a balance of technical excellence and a collaborative mindset, working closely with cross-functional teams to resolve issues.

astroPortfolio.shortDescription: Comprehensive functional QA for multiple high-profile AAA titles.
astroPortfolio.challenge: Ensure a smooth, bug-free experience for players across complex game systems and hardware platforms.
astroPortfolio.approach: Executed manual test plans, performed exploratory and regression testing, and documented over 1000 bugs using Jira.
astroPortfolio.result: Contributed to a significantly higher quality bar for released titles, helping prevent critical issues from reaching players.

coreprotectWebUI.shortDescription: Managed hardware and software demands for a network of 1,000+ users.
coreprotectWebUI.challenge: Maintain critical IT infrastructure for a large government secretariat, ensuring minimal downtime for essential public services.
coreprotectWebUI.approach: Provided hands-on technical support, diagnosed and resolved hardware and software issues, and managed user demands under pressure.
coreprotectWebUI.result: Developed strong resilience and problem-solving skills, ensuring continuous operation for a large user base.
